recent.text: Final: Heat 137, #Pistons 117 Cunningham: 33 pts, 8 asts, 5 rebs Huerter: 20 pts
recent.author: Coty M. Davis

recent.text: FINAL: Heat 137, Pistons 117. Couldn’t slow down Giannis (34-14-8) or Klay (26 points, 6-11 from 3). Couldn’t shoot, making 11-of-34 3-pointers (32%). Fall to 8-4 overall. Cunningham: 33 points, 8 assists, 5 rebounds Huerter: 20 points, 7 assists, 3 blocks
recent.author: Omari Sankofa II

recent.text: End of 3: Heat 103, Pistons 86. Outscored 66-47 in the 2nd and 3rd quarters. Shooting 38% overall and 10-30 (33%) from 3. Hasn’t been their night. Cunningham: 21 pts, 8 assts Huerter: 18 pts Robinson: 10 pts
